quizzes.question_text: Of the houses in Ronald's neighbourhood, 1/12 are blue and another 5/6 are green. What fraction of the houses are either blue or green? Write your answer as a fraction. of the houses=_
solution: Find the fraction of the houses that are either blue or green by adding 1/12 and 5/6.
You can use 12 as the common denominator.
Multiply the numerator and the denominator of $\frac{5}{6}$ by 2 to find an equivalent fraction. $\frac{5 \times 2}{6 \times 2} = \frac{10}{12}$
Now add the fractions. Add the numerators and keep the denominators the same. $\frac{1}{12} + \frac{10}{12} = \frac{11}{12}$
The fraction of the houses that are either blue or green is 11/12.
